properties.name: Endpoints
properties.comment: Descriptors of Media Stream Endpoints that belong to this object.

properties.name: StreamSourceRegistryONo
properties.comment: Object number of associated Aes67StreamEndpointRegistry object, or zero if there is no SSR. May be read-only.

methods.name: SetStreamSourceRegistryONo
methods.comment: Sets the StreamSourceRegistryONo property. Shall not be implemented when the property is read-only.

methods.name: ConfigureEndpointFromSDP
methods.comment: Optional method. Configures an Endpoint from a given SDP string. If SDPString is null, closes any active connection through the Endpoint and sets its EndpointStatuses entry to NotReady. On success: configures connection parameters from the selected Media Description; sets AdaptationData.ActiveSDP, MediaIDType, and MediaID; sets IPParameters.SourcePort from the associated m= line port; sets EndpointStatuses to Ready; does not start stream data transfer.

arguments.name: EndpointID
arguments.comment: IDInternal of Endpoint to be configured.

arguments.name: SDPString
arguments.comment: The SDP string. Null string closes the active connection.

arguments.name: MediaIDType
arguments.comment: What kind of identifier MediaID is. Shall not be None when SDPString contains multiple Media Descriptions.

arguments.name: MediaID
arguments.comment: Identifier of target Media Description within SDPString.
